seo.title: Leadership Team
seo.description: Meet the leadership team behind Altarious Global: the founder, chief executive and managing director guiding our performance marketing, inbound call and live transfer programs.

hero.headline: The leadership behind Altarious Global.
hero.subheadline: A focused leadership team accountable for strategy, client outcomes and the operational discipline behind every program we run.

members.name: Shahid Khan
members.bio: Founded Altarious Global and sets the company's direction, partnerships and long-term growth strategy.

members.name: Sajid Khan
members.bio: Leads the business day to day, with responsibility for commercial performance, client relationships and the standards every program is held to.

members.name: Rohan Jha
members.bio: Oversees operations and delivery, ensuring campaigns, qualification and routing run to plan across every vertical we serve.

cta.headline: Talk to the team directly.
cta.text: Tell us about your acquisition goals and a member of our leadership team will scope the right program with you.
